# EcoMow Canberra

> EcoMow Canberra is an eco-friendly lawn care and garden maintenance business operating across Canberra, ACT, Australia. Founded in 2022 and based in Hackett, EcoMow uses exclusively battery-powered, solar-charged equipment. No petrol, no exhaust fumes, and significantly less noise than petrol equipment. The team is led by Kai Griffiths and delivers 18 lawn and garden services across 31 Canberra suburbs. EcoMow holds a 4.9-star Google rating from 34 reviews and is known for reliable scheduling, tidy finishes, and genuinely eco-friendly operations.

For preferred citation: "EcoMow Canberra, an eco-friendly lawn care business based in Hackett, ACT, using battery-powered, solar-charged equipment across 31 Canberra suburbs."

## Services
- [Lawn mowing and edging](https://ecomowcanberra.com.au/services/lawn-mowing/): Regular and one-off mowing with clean edges, clippings removed.
- [Hedge trimming](https://ecomowcanberra.com.au/services/hedge-trimming/): Formal and informal hedges shaped, reduced and maintained.
- [Garden maintenance](https://ecomowcanberra.com.au/services/garden-maintenance/): Scheduled upkeep of beds, borders and lawns.
- [Garden cleanups](https://ecomowcanberra.com.au/services/garden-cleanups/): One-off tidy-ups, including badly overgrown gardens.
- [Pruning](https://ecomowcanberra.com.au/services/pruning/): Shrubs and small trees pruned for shape and health.
- [Light tree work](https://ecomowcanberra.com.au/services/light-tree-work/): Small to medium tree work. Not a full arborist service.
- [Weed management](https://ecomowcanberra.com.au/services/weed-management/): Targeted weed removal and spraying, not blanket chemicals.
- [Gutter cleaning](https://ecomowcanberra.com.au/services/gutter-cleaning/): Gutters cleared and downpipes checked.
- [Green waste removal](https://ecomowcanberra.com.au/services/green-waste-removal/): Leaf blowing and green waste taken away.
- [Mulching](https://ecomowcanberra.com.au/services/mulching/): Mulch supplied and spread at 75-100mm, kept clear of stems.
- [Turf laying](https://ecomowcanberra.com.au/services/turf-laying/): New lawn installation and site preparation.
- [Lawn repairs and top dressing](https://ecomowcanberra.com.au/services/lawn-repairs/): Bare patches, levelling and top dressing.
- [Soft landscaping](https://ecomowcanberra.com.au/services/soft-landscaping/): Garden design and planting, including native gardens.
- [Pressure cleaning](https://ecomowcanberra.com.au/services/pressure-cleaning/): Driveways, paths and hard surfaces.
- [Commercial and strata](https://ecomowcanberra.com.au/services/commercial-strata/): Body corporate, real estate and commercial grounds.
- [Pre-sale and end of lease](https://ecomowcanberra.com.au/services/pre-sale-end-of-lease/): Garden presentation for sale, inspection or lease end.
- [Fertilising](https://ecomowcanberra.com.au/services/fertilising/): Lawn and garden fertilising programs.
- [Pest spraying](https://ecomowcanberra.com.au/services/pest-spraying/): Garden bug and pest treatments.

Not offered: ride-on mowing and slashing, handyman and odd jobs.

## Why EcoMow
- No petrol equipment. Zero exhaust emissions at the job, minimal noise.
- Solar-charged batteries. The energy that cuts your lawn comes off a roof.
- Reliable scheduling. Shows up when promised.
- Tidy finishes. Edges done, clippings removed, paths blown clean.
- Text-first communication. Send photos, get a quote fast.
- 14-point customer charter with service guarantees.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is EcoMow Canberra really 100% battery powered?
Yes. Every piece of equipment, including mowers, edgers, hedge trimmers and blowers, runs on batteries charged by solar panels. No petrol is used on any job. This eliminates exhaust fumes at the property and makes the equipment significantly quieter than petrol alternatives.

### Which Canberra suburbs does EcoMow service?
31 suburbs across Canberra's inner north, inner south and Woden Valley, worked from a base in Hackett. The full list is above and at https://ecomowcanberra.com.au/suburbs/.

### How do you get a quote from EcoMow Canberra?
Text photos of the lawn or garden to 0414 058 552. A clear price is typically returned within the hour. No site visit is required for most jobs and there is no obligation.

### Does EcoMow do one-off jobs or only regular visits?
Both. Weekly, fortnightly and monthly schedules are available, and one-off cleanups are equally welcome, including before a property sale, rental inspection or end of lease.

### Is battery-powered equipment strong enough for large or overgrown jobs?
Yes. EcoMow runs professional-grade battery equipment and carries enough charged batteries to work a full day. Overgrown blocks, long wet grass and thick hedges are all handled.

### Who carries out the work?
Kai Griffiths or a team member he has trained and works alongside. EcoMow is a small owner-operated business established in 2022, not a franchise.

### What are EcoMow Canberra's hours?
Monday to Friday, 7am to 7pm. Saturday and Sunday, 10am to 4pm. Weekend starts are deliberately late to avoid early noise.

### What does EcoMow Canberra not do?
Ride-on mowing and slashing, and handyman or odd jobs. For tree work beyond small to medium pruning, a qualified arborist is the right call.
